attributes.Original:
Please note that this rotation is optimised for most fights. However, V&C/OC GCDs may break mudra.
• Standard 4th GCD is the highest adps damage opener; other options trade personal damage for rdps
• Please start fights from flank, or True North may disrupt weaving
• Use rotation Settings AutoBurst False AT LEAST 5 seconds BEFORE Kassatsu ready to delay burst
• Use rotation Settings AutoBurst True to resume burst or toggle via macro
• You must stay close for Kunai's Bane before suiton buff expires
• Intercept Forked Raiju manually if desired
• Use ac Shukuchi gtoff macro for movement

Rotation behaviour (compared to Reborn):
• Uses layered ninjutsu priority (burst prep → disengage → damage)
• Adds early burst preparation (Suiton/Huton) based on burst action cooldown timing
• Includes distance-based disengage uptime (Raiton/Katon)
• Reserving mudra only for burst or uptime
• Customizable Opener and Potion Usage
• Burst delay optimization: only do fillers and prevent mudra cap when delaying. when renable burst (Huton/Suiton - Kassatsu - Dokumori - Kunai's Bane - TCJ)
• Uses explicit AoE target counting for actions around targets/self
attributes.Translated:
请注意，此循环针对大多数战斗进行了优化。但V&C/OC的GCD可能会打断忍术。
• 标准第4个GCD是adps伤害最高的起手；其他选项以个人伤害换取rdps
• 请从侧身开始战斗，否则真北可能会干扰插入
• 在生杀予夺就绪前至少5秒使用循环设置AutoBurst False以延后爆发
• 使用循环设置AutoBurst True以恢复爆发或通过宏切换
• 你必须在水遁增益消失前靠近以使用百雷铳
• 如有需要可手动拦截月影雷兽爪
• 使用ac Shukuchi gtoff宏进行移动

循环行为（与Reborn相比）：
• 使用分层忍术优先级（爆发筹备 → 脱离 → 伤害）
• 根据爆发技能冷却时间添加提前爆发筹备（水遁/风遁）
• 包含基于距离的脱离期间输出（雷遁/火遁）
• 仅将忍术保留用于爆发或输出
• 可自定义起手与爆发药使用
• 爆发延后优化：延后时仅使用填充技能并防止忍术溢出。重新启用爆发时（风遁/水遁 - 生杀予夺 - 介毒之术 - 百雷铳 - TCJ）
• 对目标/自身周围的技能使用明确的AoE目标计数

attributes.Original: Automatically turn off combat state when moving between different areas.
attributes.Translated: 在不同区域之间移动时，自动关闭战斗状态。

attributes.Original: Automatically turn off combat state during cutscenes.
attributes.Translated: 在过场动画期间自动关闭战斗状态。

attributes.Original: Automatically turn off combat state when you change your job/class.
attributes.Translated: 当你切换职业/特职时，自动关闭战斗状态。

attributes.Original: Automatically turn off combat state when your character dies.
attributes.Translated: 当你的角色死亡时，自动关闭战斗状态。

attributes.Original: Automatically turn off combat state when a duty (instance) ends.
attributes.Translated: 当任务（副本）结束时，自动关闭战斗状态。

attributes.Original: Show a popup window with the changelog when the plugin updates.
attributes.Translated: 插件更新时，显示带有更新日志的弹窗。

attributes.Original: Display the plugin's current status in the server information bar.
attributes.Translated: 在服务器信息栏中显示插件的当前状态。

attributes.Original: Show a toast notification with the combat state when changed.
attributes.Translated: 战斗状态改变时，显示提示通知。

attributes.Original: Prevents your character from moving while casting or using specific actions.
attributes.Translated: 防止你的角色在咏唱或使用特定技能时移动。

attributes.Original: This setting is only used if the rotation specifically supports automatic tincture usage.
attributes.Translated: 此设置仅在循环特别支持自动使用爆发药时生效。

attributes.Original: Enable to automatically use anti-knockback abilities when needed based on anti-knockback action list in List menu.
attributes.Translated: 启用后，根据列表菜单中的防击退技能列表，在需要时自动使用防击退技能。

attributes.Original: Enable to allow the plugin to use HP potions automatically.
attributes.Translated: 启用后，允许插件自动使用HP药水。

attributes.Original: Enable to allow the plugin to use MP potions automatically.
attributes.Translated: 启用后，允许插件自动使用MP药水。

attributes.Original: Enable to allow the plugin to use Phoenix Down item. (Experimental feature)
attributes.Translated: 启用后，允许插件使用苏生之羽道具。（实验性功能）

attributes.Original: Enable to allow AoE actions to hit targets with priority markers.
attributes.Translated: 启用后，允许AoE技能命中带有优先级标记的目标。

attributes.Original: When teaching mode is active, automatically switch your target to match the rotation's suggested action target. Useful for tanks and healers where the optimal target may differ from your current selection.
attributes.Translated: 当教学模式激活时，自动切换你的目标以匹配循环建议的技能目标。对于坦克和治疗职业很有用，因为最优目标可能与你当前选择的不同。

attributes.Original: When teaching mode is active, display the rotation's suggested target name below the Next Action icon. Shown in orange if you don't have that target selected, green if you do.
attributes.Translated: 当教学模式激活时，在下一个技能图标下方显示循环建议的目标名称。如果你未选中该目标则显示为橙色，已选中则显示为绿色。

attributes.Original: Displays rotating tips in the main panel; updates every 7 seconds.
attributes.Translated: 在主面板中显示轮换提示；每7秒更新一次。

attributes.Original: When enabled, actions you have disabled in RSR will be tinted on in-game hotbars.
attributes.Translated: 启用后，你在 RSR 中封技的技能会在游戏热键栏上以着色显示。

attributes.Original: If you have another healer on the team, their healing might put the target player(s) above the healing threshold and you'll waste MP. This interrupts the cast if it happens.
attributes.Translated: 如果队伍中还有其他治疗，他们的治疗可能使目标玩家的血量高于回退预备阈值，从而浪费 MP。若发生此情况会中断施法。

attributes.Original: It is recommended to check this option if you are playing Raids or you can plan the heal and defense ability usage by yourself.
attributes.Translated: 如果你在打高难度副本，或你能自行规划治疗与防御技能的释放，建议勾选此选项。

attributes.Original: When enabled and BossModReborn is loaded, RSR will use its timeline data to trigger defensive abilities before raidwides and tankbusters hit.
attributes.Translated: 启用且已加载 BossModReborn 时，RSR 会使用其时间轴数据，在全屏攻击和破坏加农炮命中前触发防御技能。

attributes.Original: Automatically use provoke when an enemy is attacking a non-tank member of the party while there is more than one tank in party.
attributes.Translated: 当队伍中有多个坦克，且敌人正在攻击非坦克队员时，自动使用挑衅。

attributes.Original:
1.    Self-Target Fallback:
If range is zero, always targets the player and returns all affectable targets at the player's position.
2.    Preferred Positions (OnLocations):
•    Tries to get predefined beneficial positions for the current territory.
•    If none are found and the content is a trial or raid, uses fallback points (e.g., 0,0 or 100,100 point as those are the center of arenas most of the time).
•    Picks the closest point to the player, applies a small random offset, and checks if it’s within effect range.
•    If so, returns that as the target area.
3.    Boss Positional Fallback:
•    If the current target is a boss with positional requirements and within range, uses the boss’s position (or a point within range) as the target area.
4.    Party Member Fallback:
•    Gathers party members within range + effect range.
•    Attempts to find a party member who is being attacked (tank or focus target).
•    If found, calculates whether to stay at the player’s position or move closer to the tank, based on distances and effect range.
•    If not found or not needed, defaults to the player’s position.
attributes.Translated:
1.    自身目标回退：
如果范围为 0，则始终以玩家为目标，并返回玩家位置处所有可影响的目标。
2.    优先位置（OnLocations）：
•    尝试获取当前区域预定义的有益位置。
•    如果未找到，且内容为试炼或大型任务，则使用回退点（例如 0,0 或 100,100 点，因为多数情况下它们是场地中心）。
•    选取离玩家最近的点，施加一个小的随机偏移，并检查是否在效果范围内。
•    如果是，则将其作为目标区域返回。
3.    Boss 身位回退：
•    如果当前目标是需要身位的 Boss 且在范围内，则使用 Boss 的位置（或范围内的一点）作为目标区域。
4.    队员回退：
•    收集范围内 + 效果范围内的队员。
•    尝试寻找正在被攻击的队员（坦克或焦点目标）。
•    如果找到，根据距离和效果范围计算是留在玩家位置还是靠近坦克。
•    如果未找到或不需要，则默认使用玩家位置。

attributes.Original:
When enabled, non-healer jobs (such as DPS or tanks) will only use healing abilities if there are no healers in the party, or if all healers are incapacitated (at 0 HP). 
If at least one healer is alive, non-healers will not use healing abilities.
attributes.Translated:
启用后，非治疗职业（如 DPS 或坦克）仅在队伍中没有治疗，或所有治疗都力竭（HP 为 0）时才会使用治疗技能。
如果至少有一名治疗存活，非治疗职业将不会使用治疗技能。

attributes.Original: When using a Blue Mage Rotation, RSR can automatically set your spell book to the spells required by that rotation.
attributes.Translated: 使用青魔法师转向时，RSR 可以自动将你的技能书设置为该转向所需的技能。

attributes.Original: If this is disabled, you will never use Swiftcast/Dualcast to raise players.
attributes.Translated: 如果封技此项，你将永远不会使用即刻咏唱/连续咏唱来复活玩家。
实验性。
实验性，包含 Chaotic。

attributes.Original:
This setting controls how many oGCDs RSR will try to fit in a single GCD window
Lower numbers mean more oGCDs, but potentially more GCD clipping
attributes.Translated:
此设置控制 RSR 在单个 GCD 窗口内尝试容纳多少 oGCD
数值越低表示越多 oGCD，但可能造成更多 GCD 卡顿

attributes.Original: Do NOT use with XivAlexander, BMR tweaks enabled, or NoClippy - this should automatically disable itself if they are detected, but double check first!
attributes.Translated: 请勿与 XivAlexander、启用 BMR 调整或 NoClippy 同时使用——检测到它们时应会自动封技自身，但请先双将！

attributes.Original: Dynamically adjusts cooldown and animation locks to ensure queued actions resolve immediately regardless of framerate limitations
attributes.Translated: 动态调整冷却和动画锁定，确保排队的技能无论帧率限制如何都能立即决意

attributes.Original: Connects to OverlayPlugin's WebSocket server and reacts to cactbot broadcast messages (raidwide, tankbuster, knockback, downtime/untargetable).
attributes.Translated: 连接到 OverlayPlugin 的 WebSocket 服务器，并响应 cactbot 广播消息（全屏攻击、破坏加农炮、击退、停手/不可选中）。

attributes.Original: Show a toast when a cactbot broadcast is received and mapped to a RotationSolver special.
attributes.Translated: 当收到 cactbot 广播并映射到 RotationSolver 特殊技能时，显示提示。

attributes.Original: If enabled, movement actions target the object or mob at the center of your screen. If disabled, they target the object or mob your character is facing.
attributes.Translated: 启用后，移动技能会以屏幕中心的对象或怪物为目标。封技后，则以你角色面向的对象或怪物为目标。

attributes.Original: Targets with attack markers will be prioritized for actions.
attributes.Translated: 带有攻击标记的目标将优先作为技能目标。

attributes.Original: Enemy parts, such as Titan's Heart, will be prioritized as targets.
attributes.Translated: 敌方部位，例如泰坦的核心，将优先作为目标。

attributes.Original: Targets with stop markers will not be attacked.
attributes.Translated: 带有止步堡垒标记的目标将不会被攻击。

attributes.Original: Targets with only 1 HP will be treated as invincible and ignored; for rare cases where target is invincible but is not given a status for it.
attributes.Translated: 仅有 1 HP 的目标将被视为不灭孤念并忽略；用于目标不灭孤念但未获得相应状态的罕见情况。

attributes.Original: When in a Fate, only Fate targets are considered. When not in a Fate, Fate targets are ignored.
attributes.Translated: 在 FATE 中时，仅考虑 FATE 目标。不在 FATE 中时，忽略 FATE 目标。

attributes.Original: If this is disabled, RSR will only use the game's built-in soft-targeting for allies for heals, shields, etc.
attributes.Translated: 如果封技此项，RSR 将仅使用游戏内置的友方软目标选择来进行治疗、护盾等。

attributes.Original:
Full: Use all available AoE actions.
Cleave: Use only single-target AoE actions.
Off: Do not use any AoE actions.
attributes.Translated:
完整：使用所有可用的 AoE 技能。
顺劈：仅使用单体 AoE 技能。
关闭：不使用任何 AoE 技能。

attributes.Original: Controls how much party members' HP must differ before using AoE healing instead of single-target heals. Lower values require party members to have more similar HP for AoE healing to trigger (more selective). Higher values allow AoE healing even when HP differences are larger (less selective). Adjust only if you want to fine-tune AoE heal behavior.
attributes.Translated: 控制队员 HP 差异达到多少时才使用 AoE 治疗而非单体治疗。数值越低，要求队员 HP 越接近才触发 AoE 治疗（更具选择性）。数值越高，即使 HP 差异较大也允许 AoE 治疗（选择性更低）。仅在你想要微调 AoE 治疗行为时调整。

attributes.Original: Configures the maximum simulated delay in milliseconds when using animation lock removal - this is required and cannot be reduced to zero. Setting this to 20ms will enable triple-weaving when using autorotation. The minimum setting to remove triple-weaving is 26ms. The minimum of 20ms has been accepted by FFLogs and should not cause issues with your logs.
attributes.Translated: 配置使用动画锁定移除时的最大模拟延迟（毫秒）——此项为必需，不能降为零。设为 20ms 将在使用自动转向时启用三插。移除三插的最低设置为 26ms。20ms 的最低值已被 FFLogs 接受，不应导致你的战斗记录出现问题。

attributes.Original: (Do not set too low, can rip newly aggro'd dungeon mobs off tanks).
attributes.Translated: （不要设置得太低，可能会把刚拉到仇恨的迷宫怪物从坦克身上拉走）。

attributes.Original:
If the selection mode is based on character facing, i.e., targets within the character's viewpoint are moveable targets.
If the selection mode is screen-centered, i.e., targets within a sector drawn upward from the character's point are movable targets.
attributes.Translated:
如果选择模式基于角色朝向，即角色视角内的目标为可移动目标。
如果选择模式为屏幕中心，即从角色所在点向上绘制的扇形区域内的目标为可移动目标。
